asked.item: Video in slide 3 of a carousel has no sound on Instagram
Voiceover is baked into the video file
How to keep the sound of the video

verdict.reason: The limitations page directly explains that Instagram strips audio from video slides inside a carousel even when the audio is baked into the file, and gives the Reel workaround.

steps.text: Instagram strips the audio from video slides when they are posted inside a carousel, even when the audio is baked into the video file.
This is an Instagram-side limitation, not a Blotato issue.
To keep the sound, post the video on its own as a Reel instead of inside a carousel.
